newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: GOLF-WESTWOOD SETS COURSE RECORD AT MALAYSIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WESTWOOD SETS COURSE RECORD AT MALAYSIAN OPEN.

text.p: Britain's Lee Westwood set a course record with an eight-under-par 64 on the opening day of the Malaysian Open on Thursday.
Westwood had eight birdies and no dropped shots to better the previous record of 66 set by Australian Robert Allenby in 1990.
Westwood birdied the first, fourth, eighth, 11th, 13th, 14th, 17th and 18th holes at the Saujana Golf and Country Club.
"I find playing at Saujana a good preparation for the U.S. Masters at Augusta because of the similarities in the two courses," he said.
